conclusions: Collective table and column profiles are conjunctive: either all six table ACLs and every column ACL are dormant, or exact two owner SELECT table grants plus exact one owner-to-self non-grantable accounts.id UPDATE column grant are prepared.

Column census includes system columns and every target relation. Required grant checks both array cardinality and exploded privilege count, refusing duplicate or extra empty aclitems, wrong grantor/grantee, grant option and broad or misplaced privileges.

PostgreSQL UPDATE(id) is ordinary owner write authority, not a lock-only capability. Existing NOLOGIN owner topology with zero memberships and exact read-only SECURITY DEFINER body constrain serving access; owners retain inherent ownership powers.
Operator identity checks, bounded six ONLY relation locks, pre-mutation validation, full postinstall verdict, function definition checks, and atomic statement structure remain unchanged.
Replay performs no GRANT or CREATE when the exact function exists, and the retained catalog oracle includes column/table/function xmin plus ACL bytes to detect metadata rewrites.
Table-only dormant inspection in generator remains valid because complete combined custody verdict runs before use and after installation; partial profiles refuse rather than repair.
No migration checksum, runtime table grant, owner membership, function body, or test assertion change is proposed.
